reading: Copernicus DEM licence text (COPDEM-30; GLO-90 is offered under the same free licence per AWS and the Copernicus Data Space) grants a free, worldwide, unlimited-in-time right to reproduce, distribute, adapt and combine the data, requires the attribution and no-liability notice, and states no non-commercial restriction. It does not use the word 'commercial'. Set commercialUseConfirmed to true only after you accept that reading (or have confirmation from the Copernicus helpdesk).
